avis.titre: Dewy Glass like Skin and Refreshing
avis.texte: One keep it in the refridgerator and shake well prior to pumping out for application and thank me later. This stuff is beyond great for my 67 year young skin. You see immediate results. I have used it now for 3 weeks and I can tell a difference. My skin wasn't bad prior but it was dull. It looks younger and dewy after every application. Those comments about no foam are probably not shaking well prior to pumping it. I believe it is a great value and the product has a good perfect consistency.
I expected so much from other reviews but this wasn’t amazing. I think it’s more gimmicky than anything. I think a sheet mask gives better results or other creams.

avis.titre: Great hydration and soothing effect with fine bubbles
avis.texte: I really like how fine the bubbles are—they feel gentle and absorb into the skin really well. Right after using it, my skin felt instantly more hydrated and looked fresher. I also noticed a calming effect, especially on days when my skin felt a bit irritated or tired. The texture is light and easy to use, and it doesn’t feel heavy or sticky afterward. Overall, it gives both good moisture and soothing care, which makes it a great addition to my routine. I’ve been very satisfied with the results so far.

This bubble mask is so fun to use! Within seconds, the tiny bubbles start forming and it feels really refreshing on the skin. A little goes a long way, so the jar should last quite a while. After using it, my skin feels soft, smooth, and looks more refreshed. I like that it fits easily into my skincare routine and doesn't take much time. The texture is lightweight and easy to rinse off. I've been enjoying adding this to my weekly skincare routine, and my skin always looks brighter and more hydrated afterward. Definitely a nice self-care treat!
I'm 57 years old and this bubble mask gives me hydration, firming and a nice glow. I have noticed my makeup stays put much better as well. Highly recommended.
It’s ok. Really overrated. It’s just a foamy toner thats a bit more moisturizing than usual.

Love love love this! Originally saw this on TikTok. So I came to Amazon to see if they had it here and they did! The price was better on Amazon so I ordered it! Easy application just a few pumps onto your fingertips and massage into your face. It leaves a glow on your face. I’ve noticed a tightness in my face since I’ve been using it. It’s amazing! Doesn’t irritate my skin at all and I have sensitive skin. Korean skin care is really the way to go.

avis.titre: Quick and easy to useQuick and easy to use
avis.texte: I like how quick and convenient this bubble mask is. The bubble form is really fast and it feels nice on my skin. It makes my skin glowy after use. Fragrance free . And fast absorbs. Highly recommend
Easy to apply, makes skin glowy and soft, works well under make-up. Comes out as foam, takes a while to absorb into the skin. But love the effect.
Honestly I was a little skeptical but this is a great quick fix before applying makeup. Gives you a very dewy base and everything feels lifted.

avis.titre: Easy to use can see results in skin
avis.texte: Easy to use , can actually feel it tingle see more results when used multi times a day morning night skin feels softer not sure about lift having been using about three weeks noticed some drying around forehead only a very slight tacky feeling - maybe that's the part that helps with the lift as it's foaming can see the amount your using absorbs well still quarter bottle left after multi day use for 21 days .
Love this foam mask! Truly 30 seconds to get that radiant glow. Say bye to sheet masks!
I been using this mask daily, it is something simple I added to my mornings. It takes a few minutes to fully absorb; I like how my face feels soft and fresh.

avis.titre: Found a 30 second bubble mask for my busy wife taking care of our newborn
avis.texte: I bought this because my wife and I recently have a newborn and as people know, babies take a lot of time away from you and keeps you real busy. She used to put on a face mask once in awhile to take care of her face but those requires time to put on and keep on for it to work properly. We came across this 30 second bubble mask and decided to give it a try. We assumed the product comes out as a foam that you put on your face and within 30 seconds it becomes a firm solid mask. Instead it foams up and you put it on your face and your skin absorbs it within 30 seconds or so. You could feel a thin layer of the product on the surface of your face and the face feels slightly tighter in a good way for awhile. You dont even need to wash it off. Now that is convenient for our busy baby schedule while still doing self care on the face. There are a few different versions of this product from this company that I could find that have slightly different results for the face. This one is said to be boost Elasticity and help with fine lines.

avis.titre: So sticky and mixed message instructions
avis.texte: As a 46 year old with dry and aging skin, I am always trying new products to try and prevent (and potentially undo) wrinkles. I am also a big fan of Korean skincare so I was excited to order Menokin's 30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask in the Lift Collagen version. I have never tried a bubble mask before so the idea was fascinating. The bottle arrived in a box that was sealed and the bottle itself uses a foaming pump to distribute. The directions are confusing as the box says to pump on your fingertips and massage in (very basic), but the bottle itself has the worlds tiniest print instructions and says to apply 2-3 pumps, 2-3 times. I am not sure which of these instructions are accurate so I tried both ways. Either way, this seems more like a toner than a mask. One pump left my face a bit sticky and never fully absorbed but at the same time, it felt soft and nourished. 3 pumps left my face a bit sticker and ultimately about the same, so I don't see a benefit to using much more than one pump. I do appreciate that the application method here is mess free and easy to use. The ad for this product mentions using more than 2=3 pumps will leave your skin sticky - but again, even one pump did this. Even at one pump per use, I don't see getting 70 sheet masks worth out of it. Scent wise - it has the faintest fruity or floral scent but it's so light and dissipates quickly. As far as ingredients go, I'd say this is just ok. Nothing too exciting but does contain niacinamide, hyaluronic acid an

avis.titre: Easy to use and glowy skin
avis.texte: Love the product, it is easy to use. It comes out as a foam all you need is 2 to 3 palms for your whole face, rub it all in until it’s fully absorbed! It leaves your skin very refreshed and glow. That was my experience with this project. I love the ease of use and ingredients

avis.titre: Don’t believe it don’t buy it. It didn’t work at all.
avis.texte: Not good at all break up all over my skin they didn’t do any good. It’s a rip off. I need money back.

avis.titre: A little overhyped, but a decent product.
avis.texte: I was very excited to try this as it's been super viral and I am a huge fan of bubble masks. I'd never used a no-rinse one before though, and the concept was interesting. I think the hardest part was figuring out where to put it in my routine. It works better on clean skin, but I see a lot of people saying they apply it after their toner. It will still bubble slightly on top of some products though. The consistency is extremely watery and even lighter than a lot of serums. The bubbles seemed a little underwhelming, it doesn't foam nearly as much as the other products I've tried. However after testing it several times I CAN tell that it isn't just bubbling for show while not actually penetrating the skin, it is actually working. But I think the reason for the initially underwhelming amount of bubbling is because it's meant to be a very fast (30 seconds apparently) mask, and it does foam extremely quickly. It would definitely be a great choice for someone who can't stand the feeling of traditional bubble masks, I know some cannot handle that sensation, but this is is mild and fast enough I think most could power through it. It also recommends you apply mutiple layers, so it is buildable and you can redo missed spots, although that does make me think you're going to get less uses out of the bottle than they claim, so it may be a tad expensive for the size. I do think my skin feels firmer though, and it does leave the appearance of dewy, glassy skin for a bit after you apply it.
It’s so gentle yet hyrdrating! I feel like this product alone really makes my skincare feel “whole” and complete! Love the bubble formula

Menokins 30 Second Quick Lift Mask is a clear slightly pink liquid that comes out a white foam. It is unscented. I found you can use it in multiple ways. If you put it on lightly you can keep the foam structure and kind of let the bubbles pop on their own. It melts right into your skin & the bubbles feel delicious popping. I find the bubbles last a couple of minutes. You can also spread it over your face and work it in. The foam turns to liquid easily and is very easy to spread. You can keep working it in until dry or let it sink in. I get a slight tingle from the mask & it leaves your skin glowing & moisturized. It leaves your skin slightly tacky. It really feels like I just used a sheet mask. I noticed a real difference under my eyes. This mask is perfect for the quick pick me up in the morning before makeup or before bed when your just too tired to wait the 20 minutes for a sheet mask.

This is more like a foam serum than a mask since you pat it in after application. I suppose the "mask" is part of the marketing. It is similar to a mask in that it has concentrated ingredients that target certain skin concerns and is quick to use and apply. One pump is more than sufficient, two and it leaves a sticky film. To be fair, the product listing does warn you that using too much product will result in tacky residue. Once you add your subsequent skincare products, the stickiness goes away. I didn't love the feeling and wanted to wash it off. Bonus points thought because it's fragrance free so it's not irritating to the skin! It has a decent amount of skin goodie ingredients. For the price, it's a little high for not super amazing results, but YMMV. It does hydrate and impart a little glow to your skin. I didn't notice any lift but perhaps that's an effect that happens due to consistent use. I contacted the company about a different product that I ordered because I was sent the wrong item. They were super quick to respond and sent out a replacement. I wanted to mention that here so folks know the customer service is good!

avis.titre: Instant gratification with long term benefits as well
avis.texte: This 30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask by Menokin is one of those skincare products that is slightly confusing to me. I guess it's supposed to be like a sheet mask, but without the time commitment... but it also has a mild surfactant (decyl gloucoside) in it, which is responsible for the foaming action. When I read that, I wanted to rinse it off, but this surfactant is providing a different function. In this product, the foaming action is helping to distribute the active ingredients more evenly, and it's also helping to trap them close to the skin, giving them more time to absorb. I am quite sure I used twice the amount called for, so now my skin feels sticky, but it looks amazing! This mask has no scent and no added perfume. It is fun to use because of the fizz, and it also feels very hydrating and soothing, which are two of its main goals. After using it my skin looks prettily plumped, and the fine lines between my eyebrows and on my upper lip are magically less noticeable! This is because this product is loaded with water attracting ingredients (humectants) that serve to make the skin appear smoother, firmer and plumper. Now I like a plumping mask as well as the next girl, but it's the anti aging ingredients that are going to keep me coming back to this mask. The formulation contains niacinamide, adenosine and hydrolyzed collagen, and working together these ingredients can brighten, boost collagen and elastin production, and firm and smooth the skin. This quick bubble mask is easy to use and feels lightweight when applied. The foam spreads nicely and absorbs faster than I expected, leaving my skin feeling soft and hydrated. I did notice a slightly sticky residue that lingered for a few minutes, which was a bit uncomfortable at first, but it eventually softened. While it gives a gentle glow and refreshes the skin, I didn’t see a major difference in fine lines or firmness. Overall, it’s a convenient and gentle addition to a skincare routine, though not quite the full “mask” experience I expected.

avis.titre: Not that kind of d of bubble mask
avis.texte: When I ordered this I thought it was an actual bubble mask. The kind that you put on, wait for it to bubble up and then wash it off. This is just a foam that you put on, wait for it to dry and continue with your skincare. That’s fine too but it’s not an actual wash off mask. It’s easy to use and has a pump top that foams up the formula as you pump it. It leaves skin a tiny bit sticky feeling but nothing too bad especially after you put on the rest of your skincare.

avis.titre: It does knock some wrinkles out
avis.texte: So let's first start by saying I have really dry skin and I have lost all my collagen and have gotten creepy skin on my face ,legs and arms and I need something to help me so I'll try anything right now So at first I applied it over my moisturizer and it didn't do anything but make my face really greasy so I washed it off and wash my face really good and then applied this and I didn't Pat mine in I just massaged it into my face like I do all my other products and at first I didn't really notice anything but I gave it a good 5-10 minutes then I started to notice that the crow's feet in my eyes were gone and the creepy skin next to my nose had disappeared and that my chin had plumped out but even though it does work and it makes my face look really good it has a greasy feeling that it leaves and it's kind of a dry greasy feeling I can't explain like it's a rough greasy feeling but if you can stand that then this is a wonderful product it really works it knocked out a lot of my wrinkles and I can show you in the pictures if you look at them that I put with this review and after I applied this and it left a greasy feeling I applied my moisturizer over it the greasy feeling was gone so if you can't handle the filling apply your moisturizer over and it should go away but I can say this product does work it really does work and my face really does look so much brighter it made the brown marks that I have by my eyes lighter for some reason I don't know how but it did they lightened u

avis.titre: Helps skin feel and look fresher
avis.texte: This 30 second mask by Menokin dispenses as a foam which you spread on your face. Keep rubbing until it's absorbed. You are left with a slightly tacky coating, but it continues to absorb over time. It felt like a protective film. I've used it several times over the last week and I like the way my skin feels. It contain several humectants which help the skin feel hydrated. The collagen in this mixture also works as a humectant. I like the way this mask feels and it makes my skin look fresher.

avis.titre: Multitasking foam mask for minimizing fine fine lines and pores with antiaging ingredients
avis.texte: This Menokin 30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask has become my favorite last step of my morning skincare routine. I feel a plumping effect and see smoothed fine lines. It feels a little tacky until it fully absorbs. I think it seals in my vitamin C serum as well as creating a smooth surface before I apply make up….. or not! Makeup primers that contain silicones always make me break out so I am very happy to substitute this mask for that purpose. This delicate foam has zero scent, even though it contains beneficial, botanical extracts. It also contains fabulous, softening and anti-aging ingredients – propanolol, hyaluronic acid collagen to name a few. This is a plastic bottle that contains 2.36 fluid ounces. Because it dispesnses as a foam from the pump, this should last a good long time for me. The add ad says “52 uses“, but this may vary according to how much you care to apply. If you enjoy using Korean beauty products like I do, this multitasking serum will not disappoint you. Highly recommend for any skin type.

I've been using this product daily for a couple of weeks, applying one pump to my face. It absorbs quickly—within about 30 seconds of massaging it in—and hasn't caused any irritation. There's no noticeable scent, which I appreciate, and it does provide some hydration. However, it leaves my skin feeling tacky after application, which I don’t love. Because of this, I’ve been hesitant to layer it with other products and have only been using it alongside sunscreen. The label says no rinsing is required, so I assumed it could replace my regular serum—but unfortunately, it doesn't perform as well. I haven’t noticed any significant improvement in my skin, and the sticky residue makes it less pleasant to use. While it might work for others, I don’t see enough benefit to keep it in my routine and will likely discontinue use.

I am enjoying this MENOKIN 30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask [LIFT] - [Collagen] & Niacinamide in Micro-bubbles for Anti Aging, Boost Elasticity, Fine Lines, Korean Glass Skin Care Essential. It’s different and fun to use! Just a few pumps, I spread the foamy bubbles over my face and they disappeared quickly, but left my skin feeling smooth and soft and glowing! At first, it felt a little sticky, but that went away quickly. Unscented and great for around my sensitive eye area. I love this product! It’s so much quicker and easier to use than a sheet mask, and no mess or drips! This is fantastic for my morning routine, quick, easy, fun and I feel like I’m doing something extra for my skin. A mini mask every day!

avis.titre: Helps my skin but it doesn’t sit on your face like a bubble maak
avis.texte: I thought this was going to be a foamy face in place of the bubble mask. It was not. On the bottle, the instructions state to pump 2-3 times and massage into face until fully absorbed and then repeat. No need to rinse off. I will say, this has improved my skin and quickly. I put this on my face and will say you will need to give your face a bit of time to absorb it in. After it has dried my face looked pretty wow. Looked younger, radiant and made me feel like I didn’t need as much makeup as normal. I will say you will see a difference very quickly in your skin which is very nice. Try it and you should be pleasantly surprised.

30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask. i thought it will be be sheet mask with liquid serum . but it is totally different . just apply foam on face rub and massage little and the let it absorb and dont need to wash . avis.titre: The easiest moisturizing "mask" I have ever used.
avis.texte: I don't wear much make-up except for when I go out. I'm usually in and out of my house so to leave this mask on as I go about my day would be a dust/dirt collector. So, I have been using this leave-on mask only at night, overnight as I sleep because they are very sticky. After washing my face after every time I treat my face and neck to this mask, I notice my skin is firmer and not so dragged down. My skin is brighter and the slight redness that I have around my nose is not so obvious the morning after. I am mid-century old and I still get carded so I must be doing something right. I really think this leave-on sticky mask may be contributing to my healthy skin. So yes, I do recommend this product especially if you don't mind the incredibly stickiness. The product is made in Korea.

This Korean facial mask is incredibly easy to use and offers quick-fix results in 30 seconds or less. One of the best features of this mask is its convenience. With no sheet and no need to wash off, it's perfect for those busy days when you need a quick skincare boost. Simply apply the mask, wait for 30 seconds, and enjoy the instant lift and revitalization. The bubble mask formula is gentle yet effective, creating a luxurious foam that helps to cleanse pores and remove impurities. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed, smooth, and rejuvenated, with a noticeable improvement in radiance and clarity. What I love most about this mask is its versatility. Whether I'm at home or on the go, it's a convenient option for a quick pampering session. Plus, the 3.21 fl.oz size ensures that I have plenty of product to enjoy multiple applications. Overall, I highly recommend it.

Washing my face is a very important of my facial routine just as moisturizing it. So I am as very particular as to what on it.I want something that is easy to use and that is good for it too. First of all is easy to use just like it says. All I have to do is apply a couple of pumps of foam onto my face and massage it in until it is absorbed into my skin.But the best part about it is, there is no rinsing. Wow, how easy is that? I just love that! It absorbs quickly. It doesn't makes my skin feel dry; instead it feels soft and moisturized. My face have a kind glow to it like it is healthy and firm and I even had comments of looking younger. I don't know about whether looking younger is true but it was a nice comment. I also like how firm my face is looking and there III s a brightness about it too. I think this is a good value and time saver too.

avis.titre: Not bad for a bubble mask
avis.texte: Now i understand why it's a bubble mask, you pump the foam and apply to face. Once I the face then you massage in. No need for a paper mask. I actually think that this is a better option for avoiding additional waste. I like the foam and it was easy to apply. Not sure why it's a little sticky but like slightly tacky on the skin after it dried. But a moisturizer as part your skin routine will make that disappear. I used a moisturizer after and it was fine.

avis.titre: Fun quick bubble mask for glass skin 🫧
avis.texte: I really enjoyed the MENOKIN 30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask Lift version. The bubbles start working right away and the formula sinks in fast, which I appreciate when I am in a rush. My skin feels smoother and looks a bit more lifted after each use, and it gives me a fresh, firm look without any hassle. For a quick boost that fits easily into my routine, it has been a pleasant surprise.

This is the product that Korean makeup artists actually use at their shop. Pump once or twice and gently rub for 30 seconds. It’s super easy to use and gentle to the skin. It makes the skin dewy, and I personally prefer to use it at night.

I love how quick and simple this mask is! The Menokin 30-Second Quick Mask Lift feels lightweight, absorbs fast, and instantly makes my skin look more hydrated and firm. I don’t have to rinse it off, which makes it perfect for mornings when I’m in a rush. It gives a nice natural glow and smooth base for makeup. Definitely a great product for anyone who wants quick results without extra steps.

avis.titre: A super easy to use mask
avis.texte: If you are the kind of person who loves skincare, but cannot stand a paper mask, this one is for you: it is a liquid that turns into bubbles to put on your face. It leaves your face so hydrated and luminous in only 30 seconds. You will love the results as much as I do.

I’ve been trying to use sheet masks at least once a week but i’ve been really lazy and busy so I decided to give this a shot. It’s sooo much more convienent than sheet masks cuz you don’t have to wait for it to dry and worry about it falling off during the 20 mins you wait. I‘ve been using this as a daily routine and my skin has gotten noticeably more smooth and hydrated. I think since this replaces using a sheet mask everyday using this daily has given me these results!
I love the idea of bubble toners because it's efficient and less wasteful! The product itself was very hydrating and not overly too much. The glow it gives is insane!!
I don't know what happened. When the package arrived and I opened it, it was a bottle that had only a little bit left and had clearly been used. This is the worst shopping experience I've ever had.

I was curious and excited to try MENOKIN's 30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask. I appreciate the benefits of skin care masks, but I struggle to use them consistently. I think it's a tactile thing for me; I just don't like the sensation of the mask on my face. So, I was excited to try this product, since its selling point is that you will get the benefits of a mask in only 30 seconds. Overall, I do like this bubble mask quite a bit. It is definitely quick and easy to use, which I appreciate. I ran the ingredient list through Beautypedia, and the entire list came back in the good to best range. That speaks to the high quality of the ingredients. After using this mask, my skin feels soft and smooth. However, I do have to agree with other reviewers that this mask is a little sticky. After reading the other reviews and the directions here on Amazon, I decided to use only two small pumps of product in an attempt to avoid the sticky sensation. Even with being VERY careful to use only two small pumps, my face still felt a bit sticky immediately upon application. This has stayed true with continued use of the product, again being careful to only use a small amount of product. This says to me that the issue is not just one of people over-applying the product; there is something about the product itself that gives it that slightly sticky finish.
